name: Listicle / text-overlay education

hook.visual: Static or slow B-roll under huge title card
hook.audio_or_vo: ‘N mistakes / signs / steps…’ with a surprising N or niche
hook.text_overlay: The list title — must be readable muted

beats.visual: Each item gets its own card + supporting visual
beats.vo_or_copy: One insight per item; no filler

beats.purpose: Bridge to offer as item N+1 or summary
beats.vo_or_copy: If you’re making these mistakes, here’s the fix path

cta.on_screen: Full checklist / Free guide / Learn more
cta.spoken_or_caption: Save this · Link for the full list
cta.landing_promise: Checklist or article that expands the same N items

why_it_works: Saves and shares from checklist value
Positions brand as educator before seller
anti_patterns: Too many items for the runtime
metrics_signals: Landing page scroll depth on the checklist

prompt_seeds.script: 35s ‘5 mistakes’ listicle for [niche]. Specific audience in title. Each item actionable. Soft CTA to full checklist.
